title: Setup small fixes: impersonation landing, account email lifetime, sender name, agent sets in pickers
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of Setup, filed on the maintainer's word: 「以上都同意，立卡」 (2026-11-05). Measured on `main` `b7075d9908`, with the console in dev mode, unless a line says otherwise. Test app scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

## Items

| # | Observed | Suggestion |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Impersonating from a Setup page lands the administrator on 「你没有访问此应用的权限」, because the impersonated user has no Setup access. The banner and ending it work well | Go to the home page |
| 2 | Accounts created by bulk import receive a set-password link valid for 60 minutes, while invitations last days. A new employee who reads the mail later has to ask the administrator | Align with the invitation lifetime (the seat suggests 48 hours) |
| 3 | The mail sender name defaults to `ObjectStack` while the subject and body use the configured product name | Follow the brand name until one is set |
| 4 | The permission set picker on a person offers MCP AI 助手 sets | Hide agent sets when assigning to a person |

Row 2 changes how long a credential-setting link lives, so the dev should confirm the lifetime with the security seat rather than assume it.
